_comment: Maps the clang version reported by `zig cc --version` (used as an opaque key by SPC) to the LLVM release tag the compiler-rt sources are cut from. Consumed by .github/workflows/compiler-rt-src.yml; entries are only needed when the clang version has no matching LLVM release tag of its own.

0.17.0.note: zig 0.17.0 reports clang 22.1.8, but LLVM publishes the 22.1 series as 22.1.0 only
